description: V1-V3 — Visual refresh layered ON TOP of the FEAT-001 extraction, edited only in the new files (tokens.css, styles.css) plus a small theme.js and minimal index.html markup. V1: light-mode token set with automatic @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) AND manual [data-theme] toggle + FOUC guard, default stays DARK. V2: calmer palette promoting --accent cyan for active/CTA, hazard reds reserved. V3: remove the HUD .scanlines overlay entirely, keep the vignette (reduce it in light mode). DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (must run after it; edits the extracted files).
steps: V1 tokens: in web/tokens.css, keep the existing :root as DARK defaults (unchanged). Add light overrides setting the SAME token names to light values via `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) { :root:not([data-theme]) { ... } }` (auto) and `:root[data-theme="light"] { ... }` (manual), plus `:root[data-theme="dark"] { ... }` mirroring current dark defaults. Light values (tune for legibility on the light GISCO Positron basemap, keep glassmorphism): --glass-bg rgba(255,255,255,0.78), --glass-bg-light rgba(0,0,0,0.04), --glass-border/-–border rgba(30,64,120,0.18), --bg-deep #eef3fb, --bg-panel rgba(255,255,255,0.92), --text-main #0f1f3a, --text-dim #335074, --text-faint #5f7797, --primary #2563eb, keep --accent #06b6d4, --glass-blur unchanged. Mirror the chrome legacy aliases (--bg-dark, --text-secondary, --secondary-color, --border-color, --primary-color) to the same light values. KEEP hazard aliases (--danger-color, --warning-color, --success-color, --accent-color) UNCHANGED across themes.

V1 FOUC guard: in web/index.html <head>, BEFORE the tokens.css/styles.css <link> tags, add a tiny blocking inline <script> that reads localStorage 'wms_theme' and, if it is 'light' or 'dark', sets document.documentElement.dataset.theme before first paint (wrapped in try/catch).

V1 theme.js: create web/theme.js (vanilla, no modules) that on DOMContentLoaded: sets the toggle button's initial icon from the current effective theme (dataset.theme or the media query), and on click flips document.documentElement.dataset.theme between 'light'/'dark', swaps the FontAwesome icon (fa-moon in dark, fa-sun in light), and persists the choice to localStorage key 'wms_theme'. Load it from index.html via `<script src="theme.js?v=1"></script>` placed early (after the inline FOUC snippet).

V1 toggle button markup: in web/index.html add a `#theme-toggle-btn` icon button reusing the existing glass icon-button styling (model it on #restore-bottom-panel / #restore-layers-panel, styles.css lines formerly ~1442-1458, or .layer-bubble-trigger). Give it title + aria-label 'Toggle light/dark theme' and an initial . Place it near the share button (bottom-right) or in the top-right bubble column.

V1 share button theming: in web/styles.css, replace the hard-coded colors in the moved #share-link-btn rules (#93c5fd, rgba(8,20,45,0.82)) with tokens (--glass-bg, --text-dim, --glass-border, accent on hover) so the share + theme-toggle buttons read correctly in both themes.

V2 palette (value-level, subtle) in web/tokens.css + styles.css: introduce --accent (cyan) into active/open-state rules that currently rely only on --primary (e.g. `.layer-bubble-slot.open .layer-bubble-trigger`), adding accent to border/glow alongside the existing primary (a nudge, not a replacement). Optionally lower --primary-glow/--primary-dim opacity slightly for a calmer feel. Do NOT change --danger/--warning/--accent-color VALUES (JS-generated HTML reads the aliases). Leave .btn-stop red (destructive-action affordance) and multi-layer.js warning label as-is.

V3 remove scanlines: in web/styles.css delete the .scanlines rule (formerly index.html lines 99-112) and the reduced-motion `.scanlines { opacity:0 }` guard (formerly line 1482). In web/index.html remove the DOM node `
` (formerly line 1504). Confirm no scanline @keyframes exist (none do).

V3 vignette: keep #map::after vignette in dark mode; in web/styles.css add a light-theme override (`:root[data-theme="light"] #map::after`, and the `:root:not([data-theme])` under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light)`) that makes the vignette near-transparent so a dark vignette does not sit on a light basemap.

Run the full build-less verification (browser + static greps), record findings, then commit locally on develop (git add web/tokens.css web/styles.css web/theme.js web/index.html && git commit). Never push.
acceptance_criteria: With no wms_theme stored and a dark/no-preference OS, the app loads in DARK by default (no regression). With OS set to prefer light and nothing stored, the app loads light automatically. A stored choice overrides the media query.

Clicking #theme-toggle-btn flips document.documentElement.dataset.theme, swaps fa-moon/fa-sun, and persists to localStorage 'wms_theme'; the choice survives a reload with no flash of the wrong theme (FOUC guard works).
Glassmorphism is preserved in both themes; panels stay legible on a light basemap in light mode; the share + theme-toggle buttons are correctly tinted in both themes.
--accent cyan now appears on active/open UI state; hazard token values (--danger/--warning/--accent-color) are unchanged and .btn-stop is still red.
No .scanlines rule remains in any web/*.css and no `class="scanlines"` node remains in web/index.html; the CRT overlay is gone; the vignette remains in dark and is reduced/removed in light.
theme.js?v=1 and the FOUC inline snippet are present in index.html; `node --check web/theme.js` passes; DevTools Console clean in both themes.
Changes are committed locally on develop; nothing pushed.
verification: Browser (cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000): (a) clear localStorage, dark/no-pref OS -> dark default; (b) DevTools > Rendering > emulate prefers-color-scheme: light with nothing stored -> light auto; (c) click toggle -> theme + icon flip and `localStorage.wms_theme` updates; (d) reload -> stored theme applied with no FOUC (throttle network to observe first paint); (e) confirm glass panels legible in light, share/toggle buttons tinted, active bubble shows cyan accent, no scanline overlay, vignette present in dark; Console clean in both themes.
findings: FEAT-002 (V1-V3) complete, layered on top of the FEAT-001 extraction; all edits confined to web/tokens.css, web/styles.css, new web/theme.js, and minimal web/index.html markup (FOUC snippet + links + toggle button). NO toolchain/build step added. V1 TOKENS (tokens.css): the original :root stays the DARK default (unchanged). Added three theme blocks setting the SAME token names to light values: `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light){ :root:not([data-theme]){...} }` (auto), `:root[data-theme="light"]{...}` (manual), and `:root[data-theme="dark"]{...}` mirroring the dark defaults so a manual dark choice overrides a light OS pref. Light values per plan: --glass-bg rgba(255,255,255,0.78), --glass-bg-light rgba(0,0,0,0.04), --glass-border/-border rgba(30,64,120,0.18), --bg-deep #eef3fb, --bg-panel rgba(255,255,255,0.92), --text-main #0f1f3a, --text-dim #335074, --text-faint #5f7797, --primary #2563eb, --accent kept #06b6d4; legacy chrome aliases (--bg-dark, --text-secondary, --secondary-color, --border-color, --primary-color) mirrored. --glass-blur unchanged (glassmorphism preserved both themes). HAZARD ALIASES (--danger-color/-warning-color/-success-color/-accent-color and --danger/--warning) are NOT overridden in any theme block => theme-invariant (verified: those tokens appear only in the base :root). V1 FOUC GUARD: inline blocking <script> in index.html <head> at line 25, BEFORE the tokens.css/styles.css links (lines 28-29), reads localStorage 'wms_theme' and sets documentElement.dataset.theme in try/catch. V1 theme.js: new vanilla (no-modules) file loaded via <script src="theme.js?v=1"> at line 32 (after the FOUC snippet); on DOMContentLoaded sets the toggle icon from the effective theme (dataset.theme or the prefers-color-scheme media query, default dark), and on click flips dataset.theme light<->dark, swaps fa-moon(dark)/fa-sun(light), persists to localStorage 'wms_theme'. `node --check web/theme.js` PASSES. V1 toggle button: #theme-toggle-btn glass icon button added in index.html (bottom-right, stacked above the share button at bottom:72px) with title+aria-label 'Toggle light/dark theme' and initial <i class="fa-solid fa-moon">; styled in styles.css reusing the glass icon-button pattern. V1 share button theming: #share-link-btn hard-coded colors (#93c5fd, rgba(8,20,45,0.82), rgba(59,130,246,0.16), rgba(6,182,212,0.3)) replaced with tokens (--glass-bg, --glass-border, --text-dim, accent on hover); share + toggle share one rule so both read correctly in both themes. V2 PALETTE (subtle, value/usage-level): .layer-bubble-slot.open .layer-bubble-trigger now uses --accent for border + --accent-glow for glow (and --primary-dim bg) instead of hard-coded cyan literals; #restore-*-panel:hover nudged to add --accent border + --accent-glow. --danger/--warning/--accent-color VALUES unchanged; .btn-stop still red (uses --danger, untouched, styles.css ~984-994); multi-layer.js warning label untouched. V3 SCANLINES: removed the .scanlines rule and its reduced-motion `.scanlines{opacity:0}` guard from styles.css, and removed the <div class="scanlines"> DOM node from index.html. The #map::after vignette is KEPT in dark; added light-theme overrides (`:root[data-theme="light"] #map::after` and the `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light){ :root:not([data-theme]) #map::after }`) reducing it to near-transparent so a dark vignette doesn't sit on the light GISCO Positron basemap. No scanline @keyframes existed. STATIC VERIFICATION: node --check web/theme.js PASSES; grep -c scanlines web/styles.css => 0; grep -c scanlines web/tokens.css => 0; grep -c 'class="scanlines"' web/index.html => 0; 'theme.js?v=1' present (1); '#theme-toggle-btn' present (1); FOUC 'wms_theme' snippet present (1); <style> blocks in index.html => 0. BROWSER CHECK: the python3 -m http.server + DevTools (prefers-color-scheme emulation, FOUC-on-reload, console-clean) part of the verification could NOT be run in this harness (no background servers / no browser), same constraint FEAT-001 noted; the static greps + node --check above are the authoritative build-less gate. CACHE-BUSTING: theme.js is new (?v=1); only web/ CSS/JS that changed are tokens.css/styles.css (already ?v=1) and the new theme.js; no other ?v= touched. Committed locally on develop; NOT pushed.
